items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire and
1 year of staff RN experience required.
Comprehensive Clinical Care: Complete precise assessments, admissions, transfers, and discharges, ensuring all documentation meets rigorous hospital policy and regulatory standards.
Telemetry & Cardiac Monitoring: Expertly monitor and interpret cardiac telemetry rhythms, identifying arrhythmias and responding rapidly to changes in patient status.
High-Acuity Risk Management: Identify predictable patient problems and life-threatening conditions, initiating appropriate evidence-based interventions and Rapid Response protocols as needed.
Holistic Patient Assessment: Evaluate the psycho-social, spiritual, and cultural needs of diverse patient populations to develop effective, individualized discharge plans.
Physiological & Environmental Analysis: Recognize the direct relationship between physiological patient status and environmental factors to optimize healing and recovery.
Support & Education: Identify and reinforce effective patient and family coping mechanisms, providing clear education to ensure continuity of care and improved long-term health outcomes.
Associate Of Nursing Graduate of accredited Registered Nurse (RN) program required
Registered Nurse: CA, upon hire and
Advanced Cardiac Life Support, upon hire
